title: Clear the frontend follow-redirects high advisory so the dependency gate is green again
goal: Refresh node_modules/follow-redirects in frontend/package-lock.json from 1.16.1 to 1.16.2 so GHSA-mrwp-f3q8-3g9p (high, range >=1.16.0 <=1.16.1, reached through axios@1.20.0) stops failing the hosted Dependency Vulnerabilities and Security Gates jobs, without changing any other dependency or source file and without cutting a foundation release.
findings: The advisory landed under a pinned transitive dependency, so the gate goes red with no repository change: main run 41169290115 failed with NPM_AUDIT_FRONTEND_RESULT=failure.
1.16.2 is the only published version outside the advisory range that still satisfies the axios constraint, so the narrowest correct fix is a single lock entry refresh.

npm audit fix would also re-resolve @typescript-eslint/*, i18next and react-i18next; npm update rewrites unrelated libc fields on optional platform packages. Both were rejected and the version/resolved/integrity triple was edited directly, then proven with npm ci.
frontend/package*.json are not foundation sharedPaths, so this does not require a new tag; pantheon-ops carries the same pin and fixes it in its own repository in the same round.

in: frontend audit high/critical back to zero
this task packet, manifest and evidence
out: any other frontend dependency re-resolution, including the 19 moderate advisories

implementationNotes: The lock entry is edited in place (version, resolved URL, integrity) and installed with npm ci --ignore-scripts, which fails if the edited lock and the resolver disagree.
No overrides entry is added: 1.16.2 already satisfies axios's range.
The 19 moderate advisories are below --audit-level=high and need major lint/coverage toolchain upgrades, so they stay out of an unblocking patch.

reviewers: 最小性：diff 是否只有 follow-redirects 的 3 行

边界：是否越界到其他依赖、workflow 或源码
